purpose: Make a polite prediction or invite agreement.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
express feelings speak politely show respect
Plain clause + でしょう; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ.
It will probably rain this afternoon.
This question is difficult, is it not?
Ms. Tanaka is probably in a meeting now.
formation: Plain clause + でしょう; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ.
restrictions: Rising intonation often asks the listener to confirm; context distinguishes that from prediction.
mistake: Use 学生でしょう, not 学生だでしょう.
